title: A published Space website looks like a website: a full-width cover, a menu of the Space's own sections with a Book button, a real footer, and the Space page's column width

source.ref: Owner review of danieltyack.com 2026-10-06: 'it looks like trash. Let's make the header image full width. Create a header menu related to the features of the space. Create a site footer as well. The width of the center column should be the same as the site page.' Plus 'Make Frequency Partner a clickable logo / text'. White label sites build ADR-1708

detail:
FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-06. THE CONSEQUENCE: the first live client site (danieltyack.com) rendered as the app's Space page in a thin frame: a boxed cover card, a header with only the brand, a one-line footer, so it read as an app page rather than a business website. THE FIX: the Website state only (the visitor and logged-in Space pages are untouched). SiteHero is a full-width cover at the saved focal point with the name, tagline and a Book button. The header menu is built from the blocks placed on Home (components/sites/site-nav.ts maps block ids to section anchors the blocks already render, and :has() CSS hides a link whose section rendered empty, so no client JS), plus the Space's other pages and a Book button when a booking block is placed; on a phone it folds into a details disclosure. The footer has the brand and tagline, the same links, contact details and social links, and a Frequency Partner logo plus text linking to frequencylocal.com. Home's rows render as full-width section bands (EntityGrid gains an optional wrapRow) on one shared 66rem column, the Space page's own center column, and a band whose blocks all rendered empty collapses.

2026-10-07 (LIVE-830): the owner replaced this render with the house theme (Site v4). The consequence holds there: full-width cover, a section menu built from the Space's blocks plus its header button, and a footer with the Frequency Partner link. The contact details moved from the footer into the closing band's contact card.

2026-10-10: the website header moved into components/sites/house-header.tsx (header handoff v5: one-line scrolling menu, two-row phone layout, mega panels, fade on pause). The probe reads site-chrome.tsx and house-header.tsx together; the consequence is unchanged.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const miss=[];const c=(r('components/sites/site-chrome.tsx')+r('components/sites/house-header.tsx'));const h=r('components/sites/house-home.tsx');const s=r('components/sites/house-sections.tsx');if(!/HOUSE_NAV/.test(h)||!/<nav aria-label=/.test(c)||!/cta\\.label/.test(c))miss.push('the website header has no menu built from the Space blocks or no button');if(!/hs-hero/.test(s)||!/min-height:max\\(100svh/.test(r('components/sites/house-css.ts')))miss.push('the website has no full-width cover hero');if(!/<footer/.test(c)||!/Frequency Partner/.test(c))miss.push('the website has no footer with the Frequency Partner link');if(miss.length){console.error('LIVE-811: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Re-pointed 2026-10-07 (LIVE-830): the same consequence (a full-width cover, a menu of the Space's own sections with its button, a real footer) measured on the house theme that replaced this render. Re-pointed 2026-10-10: the house header markup moved from site-chrome.tsx into house-header.tsx (header handoff v5), so the probe reads both.
